# Copilot instructions

<!--
GitHub Copilot reads .github/copilot-instructions.md. Copilot's coding agent also supports AGENTS.md.
Keep this file as a thin pointer so there is one source of truth.
-->

Follow all rules in `/AGENTS.md` at the repository root. Run the commands listed there before
proposing a change as complete. Summaries must state which commands were run and their results.
